decision.reason: [ev-bc29bf53aa1b] says the AdditionalCertificateOutputFormats feature is promoted to GA and the additional formats are now always enabled. That clearly exposes environments that explicitly disabled the gate. It does not say what the gate's default was before. If it was on by default, the proposed condition (gate explicitly disabled) is exact. If it was off, environments that never set the gate also change behavior, and P2's broader condition (gate unset or disabled) is the right one. To decide, we need the gate's maturity stage and default in 1.17, for example from the feature-gate list or the PR #7744 description; none of the other items in this section give it [ev-853844eb542e].
